class.name: NNSensorGroup
class.brief_description: Aggregates input from several sensors (or sensor groups) for a higher-level input to the consideration nodes.
class.description: Aggregates input from child [NNSensor] and nested [NNSensorGroup] nodes into a single [member NNSensors.sensor_value] using [member evaluation_method], with optional inversion via [member invert_sensor_value]. Add as a child of [NNAgent], [NNBTRoot], [NNSTRoot], or another [NNSensorGroup].

members.member: How the child sensors and sensor groups are aggregated into [member NNSensors.sensor_value]. Every enabled child sensor is evaluated regardless of the method, so its value stays current. The default is [constant NoodleNodes.EVALUATION_MEAN].
This inverts the group sensor_value by calculating: [code]sensor_value = 1.0 - sensor_value[/code]. It is applied after all the child nodes have been evaluated.
